text_block_list.text:
After our outing, as I returned to the academy
alongside Matikanefukukitaru—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!!!!
Hawaaaaaaaaa~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I-I-I messed up big timeeee!
I just crossed the main gate with my right foot...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"‘When entering the main gate, enter with your left foot first.
If you break this rule’... If you break it..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"If you walk through the main gate together with someone,
you'll end up having a massive falling out with them~~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I-I-In other words, from now on, I'll be...
having a falling-out with Trainer...!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"No waaaaay, absolutely not~~~~!!
At times like this...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I'll turn to fortune-telling for the answer!!
Honjarake! Roll on, Fortune Pencil~!!

Saying that, Matikane Fukukitaru pulled a pencil from her pocket
and rolled it forcefully across the ground...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmh!?
'Water items are good'... you say!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Something to drink, something to drink... That means juice, right!?
Please wait here, I'll go buy some~!

What Matikanefukukitaru handed to me upon returning
was the very juice
I always liked to buy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"The label is today's lucky color, and above
all, you drink it all the time, Trainer!"
choice_data_list: You really pay attention, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, absolutely! You do so much for me
all the time, Trainer!
The least I can do is know what you like!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, the reaction is extremely favorable!
With this, we've completely prevented any fallout!
choice_data_list: I should buy some juice in return.
We should buy some juice in return.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, the reaction is extremely favorable!
With this, we've completely prevented any fallout!
choice_data_list: I should buy some juice in return.
We should buy some juice in return.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hwah?! I-It's really not something you need to praise me that much for...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, but... it feels like we've gotten
even closer now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This is also thanks to rolling my fortune pencil!
Blessings, oh blessings~!

Ever since then, perhaps happy that she was praised,
Matikanefukukitaru started giving me drinks
every now and then.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh!?
You're buying one for me too!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I just didn't want to have
a falling out with you, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you're buying... ehehe,
I won't hold back!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hum hum hum hum~♪ What a windfall!
It's all thanks to the divine guidance~♪
What should I pick!

Ever since then, I started drinking juice
with Matikanefukukitaru more often
during training breaks.
